mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_project_member(project_id, user_id, role, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, role FROM afv_project_member WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id, u.username, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),u.username) name, u.status, u.deleted, CASE WHEN u.id = #{ownerId} AND #{ownerType} = 1 THEN 1 ELSE m.role END role FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN afv_project_member m ON m.user_id=u.id AND m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.deleted=FALSE WHERE m.id IS NOT NULL OR (u.id=#{ownerId} AND #{ownerType}=1) ORDER BY role,u.id

SELECT u.id,u.username,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),u.username) name,u.status,u.deleted, CASE WHEN u.id=#{ownerId} AND #{ownerType}=1 THEN 1 ELSE m.role END role FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN afv_project_member m ON m.user_id=u.id AND m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.deleted=FALSE WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.status=1 AND u.deleted=FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_project_member SET deleted=TRUE,update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE afv_project_member SET deleted = TRUE, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_project_member(project_id,user_id,role,create_time,update_time) VALUES(#{projectId},#{userId},#{role},UTC_TIMESTAMP(),UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role=VALUES(role),deleted=FALSE,update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP()
